scene: A friendly octopus vendor offers you glowing trinkets.
picture: On the wooden pier, an octopus vendor in a sailor cap stands behind a brightly lit counter on the left. The young Black woman in a yellow raincoat and green boots stands facing it holding her red umbrella. A sparkling bottle rests at centre, dangling dried kelp hangs up high, and a wooden boardwalk ascends far right.
shown: a corked bottle filled with glittering blue liquid on the stall's counter at centre
a six-armed purple octopus wearing a sailor cap standing behind the counter at left
an arched wooden ramp leading up into the city skyline at far right
